budget_semantics.attempt_limit: persistent procedural ledger under the development run store
budget_semantics.captured_output: application-enforced byte caps on captured stdout/stderr
budget_semantics.numerical_threads: per-case environment caps and a threadpoolctl pre-launch check; numerical libraries must report one thread
budget_semantics.process_count: sampled process-tree monitor; not a job-object boundary
budget_semantics.rss: sampled soft monitor; not a hard memory/commit limit
budget_semantics.temporary_and_archive_size: sampled size monitoring; not an NTFS quota
budget_semantics.wall_timeout: watchdog-triggered process-tree termination; best-effort OS control
